chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Salim from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from Umar ibn Abu Hasana al-Jammal who said:
I complained to Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the scarcity of children, so he said to me: 'Seek forgiveness of Allah and eat eggs with onions.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Hassan (AS) recommend for increasing offspring?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Umar ibn Abu Hasana seeks a remedy for infertility from Imam al-Hassan al-Askari (AS), who prescribes a combination of spiritual purification through *Istighfar* and a specific dietary regimen of eggs with onions. This reflects the Shia tradition of integrating physical health (*tibb*) with spiritual devotion, suggesting that divine forgiveness can facilitate natural biological processes. The specific mention of eggs and onions highlights the importance of practical, accessible remedies in daily life as part of a holistic approach to well-being.
